title: [SPEC] คำต้องห้าม — Mobile Party Game (Construct 3 + Colyseus)
description:
Phase A: Sage creates BRD + SRS + UX Blueprint.

## Product Vision
Mobile-first web party game based on the viral Thai game "คำต้องห้าม" by เทพลีลา. Players sit together face-to-face, hold their phones up showing a secret word they CANNOT see — they communicate by SPEAKING and BODY LANGUAGE (no typing). Goal: trick others into saying their own forbidden word while avoiding yours.

This is NOT the western Taboo game. This is the Thai "เทพลีลา" format.

---

## Phase A Answers

**Q1. Product:**
A mobile web party game (PWA) for the Thai "คำต้องห้าม" format. Each player holds their phone facing outward (or on forehead) showing a word visible to everyone else but NOT to themselves. Players talk face-to-face to trick others into saying their forbidden word. Built with Construct 3 game engine + Colyseus multiplayer server.

**Q2. Users:**
Thai-speaking groups age 13-35. Friends hanging out, family gatherings, office parties, school groups. MUST be sitting together in the same room. Primary device: mobile phone (Android Chrome + iOS Safari). 2-8 players per room.

**Q3. Problem:**
The physical board game "คำต้องห้าม" by เทพลีลา sold out instantly and is hard to find. Headbands break, cards run out. A mobile version means: unlimited cards, no physical equipment needed, just phones everyone already has. Play anytime anywhere with friends.

**Q4. Stage:**
MVP from scratch. No existing codebase.

**Q5. Market:**
Thailand. UI entirely in Thai. Card words in Thai. Future: English.

**Q6. Top 3 must-haves for v1:**
1. ROOM-BASED MULTIPLAYER: Host creates room -> gets 4-letter code -> friends join via code or QR scan -> all connected via WebSocket (Colyseus). Minimum 2, maximum 8 players.
2. CORE GAME LOOP: Phone displays your secret word in LARGE TEXT (facing outward). Players talk face-to-face. Anyone can press Kill button to accuse someone of saying their word. Majority vote confirms kill. Timer per round. Survivors score points. Guess own word for bonus.
3. CONSTRUCT 3 GAME ENGINE: Built entirely in Construct 3 with event sheets. State machine (Lobby > RoundStart > Playing > Voting > RoundEnd > Scoreboard > GameOver). Export as HTML5 PWA. Mobile-optimized touch UI.

**Q7. OUT of scope v1:**
- Native app (PWA only)
- Online play with strangers (must be same room)
- Voice/video chat (players talk in person)
- User accounts/login (guest + nickname + avatar emoji)
- Monetization/ads
- AI opponent
- Text input during gameplay (all communication is verbal)
- English language

**Q8. Tech stack:**
- Game Engine: Construct 3 (HTML5 export, event sheets, behaviors, PWA)
- Multiplayer Server: Colyseus (Node.js, WebSocket, room management, state sync)
- State Machine: Construct 3 event sheets + Colyseus server-authoritative state
- Card Data: JSON files bundled in Construct 3 project + Claude API for generating new packs
- Hosting: Colyseus on Railway/Render + Static HTML5 on Vercel/Netlify
- No database needed for v1 (all state in memory, cards in JSON)

**Q9. Compliance:**
No PII collected. Family-friendly words only (no vulgar). No gambling. PDPA N/A.

**Q10. Success in 3 months:**
- 500+ games played per week
- Average 4+ players per room
- Room creation to first round < 15 seconds
- Works on mid-range Android (< 2 sec load)
- Players share room codes via Line organically
- 20+ card categories x 50+ words each

---

## Game Rules (เทพลีลา Format)

### Setup
1. 2-8 players sit together in same physical location
2. Each player joins room via phone (QR or room code)
3. Host picks category and number of rounds
4. Host presses START

### Each Round
1. Server assigns a unique common Thai word to each player
2. Phone displays YOUR word in large text
3. Player holds phone outward (others see your word, you dont)
4. FREE CONVERSATION begins — talk, ask, joke, bait
5. Goal OFFENSE: trick others into saying THEIR word
6. Goal DEFENSE: avoid saying YOUR word (which you cant see)

### Kill Mechanic
1. When someone says their forbidden word, ANY player presses the Kill button
2. Accuser selects WHO they are accusing
3. All other players VOTE: Did the accused really say their word?
4. Majority YES = Kill confirmed (accused is eliminated, loses points)
5. Majority NO = False accusation (accuser loses points)

### End of Round
1. Timer runs out OR only 1 player remains
2. Surviving players can attempt to GUESS their own word
3. Correct guess = bonus points
4. Scoreboard shown

### Scoring
- Killed (said own word): -3 pts
- Survived round: +5 pts
- Guessed own word correctly: +3 pts
- Successful accusation: +2 pts
- False accusation: -1 pt

---

## Game State Machine

LOBBY -> COUNTDOWN (3-2-1) -> PLAYING -> [VOTING] -> ROUND_END -> SCOREBOARD -> [NEXT_ROUND | GAME_OVER]

- LOBBY: Players join, host configures, start button
- COUNTDOWN: 3 second countdown, phones show Hold your phone up!
- PLAYING: Words displayed, timer running, Kill button active
- VOTING: Triggered by accusation, all players vote, timer paused
- ROUND_END: Reveal all words, survivors guess, calculate scores
- SCOREBOARD: Rankings with animations
- GAME_OVER: Final rankings, share results, play again

---

## Screen Designs (Mobile Portrait)

### Screen 1: Home
- Game logo + title
- Create Room button
- Join Room button (enter code or scan QR)
- Category browser

### Screen 2: Lobby
- Room code (large, copyable) + QR code
- Player list with emoji avatars
- Category selector dropdown
- Round count selector (1-5)
- Timer per round selector (2/3/5 min)
- START button (host only)

### Screen 3: Game (Main)
- YOUR forbidden word in HUGE text (150px+, bold, centered)
- Background color = your player color
- Timer countdown (top)
- Alive players count
- Kill button (red, bottom, large thumb-friendly)
- Guess My Word button (small, corner)
- Surrender button (small, corner)

### Screen 4: Kill Vote
- Who is accused (name + their word revealed)
- Vote buttons (Killed / Not Yet)
- Vote progress bar
- 15 second vote timer

### Screen 5: Guess Phase
- Text input: type what you think your word is
- Submit button
- Result: Correct! +3 pts or Wrong! (reveal actual word)

### Screen 6: Round End
- All players listed with their words revealed
- Status icons (skull for killed, star for survived, brain for correct guess)
- Points earned this round

### Screen 7: Scoreboard
- Ranked list with total points
- Animations (confetti for winner)
- Next Round / Back to Lobby buttons

### Screen 8: Game Over
- Final rankings with crown for winner
- Share button (generate image for Line/social)
- Play Again button

---

## Card Data Structure

```json
{
  "category": "คำทั่วไป",
  "icon": "💬",
  "difficulty": "easy",
  "words": ["อีก", "ไป", "มา", "ดี", "เอา", "ให้", "ทำ", "ได้", "จริง", "ใช่", "ไม่", "แล้ว", "ก็", "อ่า", "นะ", "ครับ", "ค่ะ", "เลย", "มาก", "น่า"]
}
```

Categories for v1: คำทั่วไป, อาหาร, สัตว์, อาชีพ, สถานที่, อารมณ์, กีฬา, สี, ร่างกาย, ครอบครัว

---

Please produce complete: BRD + SRS + UX Blueprint + Technical Architecture for Construct 3 + Colyseus implementation.

title: [SPEC] Web Game: คำต้องห้าม (Taboo) — Mobile-first Multiplayer with Custom Game Engine
description:
Phase A: Sage creates BRD + SRS + UX Blueprint for Thai Taboo web game.

## Product Vision
Mobile-first web party game inspired by Taboo, localized for Thai. Players create rooms, invite friends via code, compete in real-time word-guessing.

## Phase A Answers

**Q1. Product:** Thai web Taboo game. Describe target word without 5 forbidden words. Runs in Chrome mobile.

**Q2. Users:** Thai-speaking casual gamers 15-35. Friends, families, office teams. Primary: mobile phone.

**Q3. Problem:** No good Thai Taboo online. Physical game expensive, cards run out. This = unlimited AI cards + play anywhere via room codes + no install.

**Q4. Stage:** MVP from scratch.

**Q5. Market:** Thailand / Thai-speaking. UI Thai. Future: English.

**Q6. Must-haves v1:**
1. Room-based multiplayer (create room > share code > join > play) via WebSocket real-time
2. Custom Game Engine — state machine (lobby > round > turn > scoring > next-round > game-over), timer, turn rotation, scoring logic, ECS-inspired
3. Mobile-first UI — touch-optimized, large buttons, swipe gestures, haptic feedback

**Q7. OUT of scope v1:**
- Native app (PWA only)
- Voice chat
- User accounts/login (guest + nickname)
- Monetization/ads
- English support
- Tournament/ranked mode

**Q8. Tech stack:**
- Frontend: React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js + Express + Socket.io
- Game Engine: Custom TS with FSM pattern, ECS-inspired
- AI: Claude API (card gen + forbidden word detection + solo guesser)
- DB: PostgreSQL
- Hosting: Vercel or self-hosted
- PWA service worker for offline card display

**Q9. Compliance:** No PII, family-friendly content moderation, no gambling, PDPA N/A.

**Q10. Success 6mo:**
- 1000+ MAU
- Avg session 15+ min
- 50+ categories x 100+ cards
- Room to first round < 30 sec
- Works on mid-range Android < 3 sec load

## Game Modes
1. Solo vs AI — player types clues, AI guesses
2. Multiplayer Room — 4-10 players, 2 teams, real-time
3. Party Mode — pass-the-phone, single device

## Game Engine Requirements
- Finite State Machine: Lobby > RoundStart > TurnActive > TurnEnd > RoundEnd > GameOver
- Timer system (configurable 30/60/90 sec per turn)
- Turn rotation (team A player 1 > team B player 1 > team A player 2...)
- Scoring: +1 correct guess, -1 forbidden word used, skip = 0
- Power-ups: Skip (limited), +15 sec, Reveal 1 taboo word to opponent
- Anti-cheat: server-authoritative state, client only renders
- Reconnection handling via WebSocket

## Card System
- Categories: Thai food, celebrities, tech, movies, places, Thai idioms, animals, sports
- Each card: target word + 5 forbidden words
- AI generates new cards on demand
- AI Judge detects forbidden words (Thai morphology, synonyms, root words)

Please produce: BRD + SRS + UX Blueprint
